title: Assistance for Societies Holding AGMs or Governance Meetings during COVID-19 Outbreak
what_it_is: Assistance for Societies Holding AGMs or Governance Meetings during COVID-19 Outbreak

sections.label: Alternative meeting arrangements legislation
sections.summary: The Government announced legislation allowing entities, including societies, to adopt prescribed alternative arrangements for meetings compliant with safe distancing measures.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Government has announced legislation that will allow entities, including societies, to adopt prescribed alternative arrangements so that meetings can be conducted in a manner compliant with the safe distancing measures announced on 24 March 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: These prescribed alternative measures can be adopted notwithstanding the requirements in the entities’ constitution.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: They include allowing a meeting to be held by video-conferencing or other electronic means, or to be postponed, or for the quorum of a meeting to be reduced.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In view of the COVID-19 situation, the Registry of Societies (ROS) will allow societies to adopt such alternative arrangements.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: ROS will advise societies on the details soon.

sections.label: COVID-19 Temporary Measures Bill guidelines
sections.summary: Clear guidelines are needed to avoid misunderstandings, and this is in the COVID-19 (Temporary Measures) Bill tabled today.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: So, they really do need very clear guidelines on what they can and cannot do to avoid any misunderstandings.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: It is in the COVID-19 (Temporary Measures) Bill that will be tabled today.
